entry.author: wbopdc
entry.summary:
A recap of the Community Quest events held across the Western Bay, as part of our Spatial Plan projects.

Council is developing spatial plans for Katikati, Te Puke, Waihī Beach/Bowentown/Athenree, and Te Puna Minden.

Once complete, they will help determine how these places grow and develop over the next 30-50 years – including where new housing goes, what infrastructure is needed, and what should be protected.

These are important decisions, and we want to make them alongside the people who call these places home!
